about: The agent builds this one step, runs its check, ticks it and stops. When it stops, the Studio shows the next step; a working agreement such as a test review may stop it earlier.
Same chat or new chat: the plan holds the state of the work; after a break, let the agent report first. Fast model: one small, well-described step.
